text:
ida: Flagging a warmstart regression on magnet13b-quant4 during onboarding. Anchor QA top-1 drops ~2.1% when resuming long prefills (>7k tokens). Quick notes and tiny repro below.

tom: Oof. Any recent snapshot-time changes?

ida: Yeswe started doing 'phase-normalize-at-snapshot' to reduce runtime overhead and switched `prefill_stride` heuristics. Repro command (use image rwinf/dev:canary-2):
```
python eval/anchor_check.py \
  --model magnet13b-quant4 --snapshot s-2026-06-15-warmstart \
  --prompt tests/anchors/long-anchor-11.txt --max-tokens 7168 \
  --kvcache-mode resume --quant-kernel quant4 --emit-json --seed 21
```
Baseline top1: 0.712, warmstart: 0.691 -> delta 0.021.

yara: Did you try forcing legacy phase compute or swapping stride?

ida: Quick local runs: `--force-legacy-phase` -> 0.709, `--kvcache-stride 128` -> 0.707. Both together -> 0.711.

devops-bot: Canary deploy s-2026-06-15-warmstart -> 2% at 2026-06-15T03:20:00Z. Alert: long_anchor_top1_drop=0.021.

tom: Sounds like an interaction: snapshot-time normalization + smaller stride increases rounding accumulation in quant4 path.

yara: I ran `tools/phase_delta_scan --snapshot s-2026-06-15-warmstart` on a canary node. Summary: 98.4% tokens delta <1e-5, 1.3% in [1e-5,1e-3], 0.3% tail >1e-3 concentrated at anchor boundaries where prefill writes are sparse. Artifact: https://s3.redwood-internal/artifacts/warmstart-phase-1777771234.json

ida: We should add a snapshot pre-commit validation that rehydrates a small trace and verifies phase continuity histogram tail < 1e-3. If it fails, block snapshot or force fp32 storage for `phase_scale`.

tom: Agreed. Low-lift mitigation: store `phase_scale` as fp32 in snapshot metadata and flip `phase-normalize-at-snapshot` back to runtime until numeric parity tests pass. I can prototype a branch.

qa-bot: Scheduled regression job: anchor-warmstart-smoke x3. CI: https://ci.redwood-internal/anchor/1777771234

yara: I'll add a unit that simulates a cross-boundary prefill write pattern and validates that quant4 accumulate ordering is deterministic; if not, we'll document a deterministic stitch order.

ida: For now pausing further percent ramp. Adding note to model-onboard checklist: "numeric parity check: phase continuity histogram".

tom: Nice. Also adding a nightly guard that runs `phase_delta_scan` on every new snapshot and uploads the histogram to artifacts.

ida: Thanks team. I'll follow up with minimal PR to serialize phase_scale fp32 and a small preflight that rehydrates the first 8k tokens before snapshot commit. :white_check_mark:
